[Confess Feelings] Marie? Can we talk?
[Koniec]
Evaluate expressions

I fear I must call him "our" devil now, non ? For he is not leaving any time soon. Ha !
RoatheFamilyDelay

RoatheDating
I do not know how you achieved what you did. But he has told us the truth of taking the serum.
RoatheRedeemed
I do not know how you achieved what you did. But he has told us the truth of taking the sérum.
RoatheVillain
I worry for him. I think he hurts himself more than he lets on, n'est-ce pas?
false
I'm sorry if this feels like it's coming out of nowhere, but I haven't known how to tell you earlier.
You have done well in getting his help with Monsieur Loid. I did not think it could be done.
I am resisting the tentation to ask you toutes sortes de commérages.
Sol, to złamało mi serce. Jego głos nie załamał się, kiedy przemówił. Mais je l'ai vu dans ses yeux.
It breaks my heart. I hope his does not shatter in his chest some day. I do not know if he will survive it. I do not know if any of us will.
I adore you. I simply adore you.
There has been a change in him. Subtle, but it is there.
Chat ends.
Well, I was wondering... if you'd like to, well... become a couple?
+5 Chemistry
Evaluate expressions
I za to jesteśmy ci wdzięczni.
Oh ! Oh, Drifter. I do not know how to say this, so I will just come right out with it, instead.
MarieNoDate
false
Och, czuję się tak samo ! Mais je ne sais pas comment te l'écrire, je n'ose pas taper les mots ! Uważałam się za głupca, że w ogóle o tym myślę !
MarieWillDate
Nie wiem, czy zawsze będzie tego chciał, ale zawsze może liczyć na swoich przyjaciół.
Non.
Ach ! Jak bardzo mnie uradowałeś !
Though I think I will never tire of shouting at him !

If you are asking for a more... formal courtship, then oui ! Oui ! I would like this.
Mam wrażenie, że aż za bardzo polubił się z drażnieniem ciebie.
Cieszę się, że znaleźliście jakieś porozumienie.
Definitely not offering marriage, not yet.
Czasy z pewnością się zmieniły. Nie nazwałbym ich bardziej "formalnymi", ale z chęcią... wszystko ci pokażę.
Comme un gros chat de gouttière. I have grown accustomed to him.
Oui ! As am I. He grows a little less insufferable every day.
Now I am the one teasing, do not worry. But, either way, je suis ravie ! And looking forward to learning these new... romantiques customs.
Hah ! I know when you are being wicked. Well. I look forward to it.
I think I would be sad if he were gone.
+10 Chemistry
Chat ends.
Until then ? À la revoyure, mon cœur.
